sentences.text:
The Commissioner Food Safety ... vs Jagannathan on 3 July,
2025

Item No.40 Court No.13 Section Xii
 S U P R E M E C O U R T O F I N D I A
 Record Of Proceedings
 Special Leave Petition (Civil) Diary No(s). 25105/2025
 [Arising out of impugned final judgment and order dated 04-10-2024
 in Wa No. 1406/2024 passed by the High Court of Judicature at
 Madras]
 The Commissioner Food Safety Department & Anr. Petitioner(s
 Versus
 Jagannathan & Anr. Respondent(s
 (Ia No. 149030/2025 - Condonation Of Delay In Filing, Ia No.
 149031/2025 - Exemption From Filing C/C Of The Impugned Judgment)
 Date : 03-07-2025 This matter was called on for hearing today.

Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Manoj Misra
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Nongmeikapam Kotiswar Singh

(Partial Court Working Days Bench)
 For Petitioner(s) Mr. Amit Anand Tiwari, Aag
 Ms. Misha Rohatgi, Aor
 Mr. Nakul Mehto, Adv.
 Mr. Amulya Upadhyay, Adv.
 Ms. Rabaica Jaiswal, Adv.
 Mr. Pranjal Mishra, Adv.
 For Respondent(s) Mr. P. S. Sudheer, Aor
 /Caveator(s) Mr. Rishi Maheshwari, Adv.
 Ms. Anne Mathew, Adv.
 Mr. Bharat Sood, Adv.
 Mr. Jai Govind M J, Adv.

Upon hearing the counsel the Court made the following
 O R D E R
1. Delay in filing the special leave petition is condoned.

2. Issue notice.
The Commissioner Food Safety ... vs Jagannathan on 3 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13847807/
1
3. Notice on behalf of respondent no.1 is accepted by Mr.P.S. Sudheer, Advocate-on-Record.

4. Learned additional advocate general for the petitioners submits that against the same impugned order, the respondent(s) has filed a special leave petition (SLP(C)Diary No.6374/2025) in which notice has been issued on 28.04.2025.
5. Tag this petition with SLP(C)Diary No.6374/2025.
6.
At this stage, learned additional advocate general for the petitioners submits that to enforce the order of the High Court a contempt petition has been filed by the respondent(s).
7. Learned counsel for the first respondent submits that he will seek for adjournment in the contempt petition and will not press the contempt petition for the time being.

(NIRMALA NEGI) (AVGV RAMU)
ASTT. REGISTRAR-cum-PS COURT MASTER (NSH)
